messages:
Priya Gomez: Quick async — small QTR runway check. Can everyone drop a one-line: what shipped, what slipped, and who owns next-step? :wave:

Morgan Lee: Infra telemetry rolled out to canary — shipped. PR merged (#423). No regressions observed.

Samir Patel: Runtime v3 KV-cache work slipped; observed perf regression in batching path after quant changes. Owner: Samir. ETA: EOW for hotfix.

Alex Chen: Embeddings migration for search index shipped and smoke-tested. :tada:

Jamie O'Neil: Privacy gating for Private deploys hit a blocker with KMS key rotation. Slipped. Owner: Jamie. Need product/legal decision on safe fallback.

Priya Gomez: Thanks — Jamie, what's the lowest-risk fallback we can ship to avoid blocking customers? (A: allow cached keys for existing nodes, B: pause new private deploys)

Jamie O'Neil: Leaning toward A to avoid customer impact, but need legal signoff. @Morgan can you escalate to Legal/Compliance? :pray:

Morgan Lee: Will do. Filing ticket now and pinging Legal. Ticket: LEG-1234.

Samir Patel: Small ask — CR pings: @Alex Chen can you review runtime hotfix PR? Link: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/789 — it's a kernel scheduling tweak.

Alex Chen: Ack, I'll review by EOD and leave inline comments.

Priya Gomez: Owner summary: Samir -> runtime hotfix; Jamie -> privacy/KMS fallback + legal; Morgan -> legal escalation + ticket; Alex -> CR review + embeddings cleanup.

Priya Gomez: Next steps: Post a 1-line update in this thread by 5pm PT today. If any slip pushes past next Wed, we schedule a 30m triage.

deploy-bot: New canary deploy started at 2024-07-12T15:12:00Z :rocket:

Samir Patel: Update: hotfix passing unit tests, integration tests running against canary. Perf locally back to baseline. Will paste logs shortly.

Priya Gomez: Great — thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
